discoveries: The trial limb begins as a student problem rather than a power-up: Masta needs Greg to walk honestly enough to expose bad information instead of compensating around it.
The emotional payoff is deliberately tiny and bodily: one second standing with both hands free, without pretending the fitting is finished.

rejected_hot.label: overacted_theatre
rejected_hot.finding: A triumphant first walk would destroy the chapter's strongest distinction between adaptation skill and honest fitting evidence.

discoveries: Work-limb progress remains conditional on skin, pressure, fatigue, gait, and repeat fitting rather than desire alone.
Greg's old competence can become a liability when it teaches his body to hide the exact mistakes the specialist needs to see.

rejected_hot.label: character_caricature
rejected_hot.finding: Making Greg master the limb unusually fast would turn earned adaptation into protagonist privilege.

discoveries: The limb thread gains force because Greg can want independence while still accepting rails, crutches, notes, and conservative limits.
Masta retains ownership of fitting decisions while Greg owns reporting what his body actually does.

rejected_hot.label: pov_crowding
rejected_hot.finding: More internal declaration about identity or wholeness would over-symbolize a practical body-learning process.

discoveries: Road testing treats the new limb as one tool among terrain-specific options, not a replacement for crutches.
Greg's progression is increasingly the ability to choose the right mobility system for the current surface and task.

rejected_hot.label: movement_saturation
rejected_hot.finding: A fall or dramatic stumble would manufacture a lesson already present in careful terrain selection.

discoveries: New mobility creates new possible work without erasing the cost of fatigue, skin monitoring, and training windows.
The manuscript lets capability widen incrementally instead of converting equipment acquisition into instant status change.

rejected_hot.label: overcompression
rejected_hot.finding: Compressing the mundane fitting and recovery intervals would remove the mechanism that makes later freedom credible.

discoveries: Greg continues to separate observation from authority even as his field experience grows, preserving the mature competence established in Duskport.
Specialists can use Greg as recorder or extra eyes without promoting him into their profession.

rejected_hot.label: character_caricature
rejected_hot.finding: A hotter expert intervention would blur the deliberately maintained boundary between transferable judgment and local craft.

discoveries: Travel logistics, body limits, and equipment custody remain one system, so choosing where and when to use the trial limb carries real consequences.
Greg's curiosity is strongest when it survives being postponed by practical constraints.

rejected_hot.label: prop_recursion
rejected_hot.finding: Letting every new instrument or route condition become a test opportunity would make restraint disappear exactly when it is becoming character growth.

discoveries: Road authority emerges through measured restrictions and conditional openings rather than binary safe/unsafe declarations.
Economic pressure is allowed to matter without overriding engineering evidence.

rejected_hot.label: overacted_theatre
rejected_hot.finding: Turning competing road needs into a villain conflict would flatten the useful alignment problem among workers, town, freight, and safety.

discoveries: Temporary repair remains temporary even when it works, and characters distinguish survived, settled, repaired, and permanently safe.
Greg's recorder role is valuable precisely because he preserves sequence and condition without upgrading his understanding into authority.

rejected_hot.label: pov_crowding
rejected_hot.finding: Having Greg synthesize the road diagnosis for the group would steal ownership from the people actually inspecting and repairing it.

discoveries: The rain-and-cribbing sequence puts real pressure on procedure while preserving specialist ownership: Toll directs repair, Halen recommends load class, Enna controls passage, Jorren owns freight consequences, and Greg records.
